description: The RANDOM-init (from-scratch) arm of the hyperplane A/B. IDENTICAL to exp010 (full ~325M HyperplaneMultiHeadLUT model — every LUT site swapped, exp752 geometry + recipe, 16000 steps, hybrid Lion+AdamW routing, bf16 LUT + fp32 master Lion, grad clip 1.0, 6L/dim384/6H, seed 42) EXCEPT hyperplane_init='random' instead of 'anchor_pairs'. exp010 warm-starts each hyperplane as exp752's fixed anchor pair (w=e_p1-e_p2, b=0) and reproduces it bit-for-bit at step 0; exp012 instead initializes every hyperplane normal randomly (Gaussian rows, std=hyperplane_init_scale=0.05 ~= 1/sqrt(input_dim=384) so <w,x> is O(1)), bias 0 — no anchor prior. Tests whether exp010's learned-hyperplane win (best 1.1940, beating exp752 1.2162 and the exp001 dense anchor 1.2014) depended on the anchor warm-start or holds from scratch. Random init should start at HIGHER loss than exp010's anchor init (which reproduced exp752 ~10.56). NOT iso-param vs exp752 (adds ~48M). exp010 reference: best_val_bpb 1.1940 @ 324.7M, 3.537h.
